blocks.text: The most common physical hazards are slips and falls when working on a wet floor; a worker must take all precautions to avoid accidents related to physical hazards such as slipping, pulling and falling. A worker should wear cut-resistant gloves while handling broken glassware to prevent cuts, abrasions and skin damage, and it should be mandatory for the laboratory staff to dispose of broken glassware in a special container to prevent injury.

blocks.caption: Physical hazards and precautions
rows: avoid slips and falls; care when pulling or lifting
cut-resistant gloves; dispose of it in the special container; report the breakage (16.1)

blocks.prompt: A test tube shatters on the bench. What should happen next?
blocks.explanation: Report the breakage to the lab in-charge at once, put on cut-resistant gloves before touching the pieces, and put the broken glass into the special container for glass, never into the ordinary bin.

items: Physical hazards: slips and falls (wet floor), cuts from broken glass; cut-resistant gloves and a special container for broken glassware.
